 def get_active_blocking_rules(con: sqlite3.Connection) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:

+def export_active_rules_json_schema(con: sqlite3.Connection, status: str = BLOCKING) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Export active security rules formatted as a JSON Schema validation document."""
+    rules = list_rules(con, status=status)
+    return {
+        "$schema": "http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#",
+        "title": f"Chronos Active Security Rules ({status})",
+        "type": "array",
+        "items": {
+            "type": "object",
+            "properties": {
+                "rule_id": {"type": "string"},
+                "language": {"type": "string"},
+                "rule_text": {"type": "string"},
+                "yaml_pattern": {"type": ["string", "null"]},
+                "status": {"type": "string", "enum": [status]},
+                "detectability_passed": {"type": "boolean"},
+                "created_at": {"type": "string"},
+                "promoted_at": {"type": ["string", "null"]},
+                "promoted_by": {"type": ["string", "null"]},
+            },
+            "required": ["rule_id", "language", "rule_text", "status"],
+        },
+        "rules": rules,
+    }
